our_interpretation: Read settled on one as LLMs becoming the prevailing approach to general-purpose AI, rather than the literal disappearance of every other method.
In the surrounding discussion, prediction most naturally refers to language prediction. A claim about superiority across every prediction domain would be substantially broader.
The surrounding examples identify reasoning and instruction following as the other abilities.
Use October 2026 for the ongoing state and performance claims. Earlier diversity is a historical comparison with no specified starting date.
Some of the other things is a scope qualification, not a conditional forecast antecedent.
criteria.support_condition: Research or deployment records establish convergence on LLMs as the prevailing general-purpose approach; matched comparisons establish their claimed prediction leadership; contemporary evaluations establish significant weaknesses in the specified other abilities.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Matched evidence refutes a material component: no such convergence, superior prediction by another approach on the intended tasks, or consistently strong performance across the other abilities being described.
